notes.title: Polygon Attack Controller Update is live!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27141021/58eafe38d3f00c2717dfffddda19c42407408151.png


Bugs fixed:


[olist]
    Fixed bug with switching music when exiting the pause menu


    Fixed a bug where one of the bosses left a laser effect after death
[/olist]


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27141021/2f885bf3a07bd05c3a8bcd6b43cf5a8622fbaa93.png


Changes list:


[olist]
    Added full support for XBox One and XBox 360 game controllers
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27141021/c562ca1c07dd91920e83369432e8a75c404160b9.png


    The launcher is removed and graphics settings are transferred to the main menu
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27141021/6c6be5af828d0fce942bc252134a302025fb123f.png


    Changed the upgrade screen, added controls hints for gamepad
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27141021/714e790235961e76f8f4e2d80cd016eaa8cd4eec.png
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27141021/ac253915ffd43fd37eed60b4624d991400226bcf.png


    Added bonus descriptions
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27141021/e6d3ef660d451a28b09e1e4c0512f1db751ba09c.png
[/olist]


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27141021/2f885bf3a07bd05c3a8bcd6b43cf5a8622fbaa93.png
